component_props_hook_signatures_defaults: Component props, hooks, defaults and rendering behavior.
shares_one_light_with_descendant_surface: Lets descendant Edge.Surface elements share one light without adding DOM elements. Each nested Edge.Provider creates an independent light.
share_one_light_with_existing_components: Share one light with existing components
an_element_can_belong_to_only_one: A DOM element can connect to only one light. Do not attach the ref to a parent element with different dimensions.
remeasures_surfaces_on_the_next_frame_ev: Remeasures surfaces on the next frame, even with a stationary pointer. Call after React commits changes to an element’s position or border thickness without a size notification.
server_rendering_does_not_access_the_dom: Content can be rendered on the server. Lighting starts after client mounting or hydration. Static HTML without client JavaScript has no lighting. Cleanup restores owned inline CSS variables, removes listeners and cancels pending frames; setup can restart in React StrictMode.
the_provider_and_marked_hosts_activate_a: The provider and connected elements activate after the client mounts.
use_rendertostring_with_hydrateroot_nati: Use renderToString with hydrateRoot. Native content and controls remain available before hydration.
node_rendertopipeablestream_and_web_rend: Node renderToPipeableStream and Web renderToReadableStream can send a Suspense fallback before delayed surfaces. Surfaces use their nearest provider when they hydrate.
generate_hydratable_html_at_build_time_f: Generate hydratable HTML at build time. For delayed content, wait for onAllReady or stream.allReady before collecting the output.
rendertostaticmarkup_produces_html_that_: renderToStaticMarkup produces HTML that cannot be hydrated. Content and surface classes remain, but lighting does not activate without client code.
react_18_and_19_are_supported_web: React 18 and 19 are supported. Web Streams are tested in Node; individual frameworks, deployed Web runtimes and hydration of incomplete streams are not verified.
connect_components_to_a_shared_light_wit: Connect components to a shared light with Edge.Provider and Edge.Surface.
both_cards_respond_to_the_same_light: Both cards respond to the same light.
subtle_highlights_for_your_ui_with_your: Subtle highlights for your UI, with your existing colors, layout and interactions.
group_elements_under_one_shared_light_an: Group elements under one shared light and choose which surfaces respond. Give an area its own light when it should react independently.
keep_components_readable_and_operable_wi: Keep components readable and operable without lighting.
keep_labels_text_contrast_base_borders_a: Keep labels, text contrast, base borders and visible keyboard focus. Decoration does not capture pointer events; input values, selection, keyboard handling and portals remain under your control.
forced_colors_mode_hides_decoration_comm: Forced-colors mode hides decoration. Communicate selection, validation and availability independently of the highlight.
each_light_queues_at_most_one_frame: Each light queues at most one frame, reads geometry before writing styles, and skips unchanged output. Gradient changes still require browser rendering work; this does not guarantee a frame rate or battery cost.
the_example_becomes_interactive_when_jav: The example becomes interactive when JavaScript is enabled.
system_respects_reduced_motion_and_devic: System respects reduced-motion and device preferences. Dynamic follows mouse or pen input, even with reduced motion enabled. Static keeps a fixed direction. Touch updates the light position in viewport coordinates. Scrolling and lifting the finger preserve the last position; surfaces respond as they move beneath it. A new touch updates the position. Touch tracking follows the selected motion mode: static stays fixed, and system stays fixed when reduced motion is enabled.
direction_in_degrees_for_fixed_lighting_: Direction in degrees for fixed lighting. Random chooses one shared direction per mount and keeps it across ordinary rerenders. Numbers must be finite.
distance_over_which_dynamic_lighting_fad: Distance over which dynamic lighting fades outside a surface, in viewport CSS pixels. Must be positive and finite.
shared_light_strength_must_be_finite_and: Shared light strength. Must be finite and between 0 and 1; invalid values throw a RangeError.
decoration_slot_choose_before_to_preserv: Decoration slot. Choose before to preserve an existing ::after. If both slots are occupied, or the element is a native input, use a wrapper. Invalid values throw a RangeError.
how_the_edge_responds_to_light_all: How the edge responds to light. All three styles preserve your component appearance.
highlight_color_follows_the_host_text_co: Highlight color. Follows the element's text color by default. Accepts any CSS color string, including a CSS variable.
color_on_the_opposite_edge_accepts_any: Color on the opposite edge. Accepts any CSS color string; use transparent to remove this shadow on a light surface.
decorative_edge_thickness_in_pixels_it_d: Decorative edge thickness in pixels; it does not change the element's border. Negative values clamp to 0. Non-finite values use the default.
multiplier_for_the_shared_light_strength: Multiplier for the shared light strength. Finite values clamp to 0–1; non-finite values use the default.
the_area_that_shares_this_light_ordinary: The area that shares this light. Ordinary children stay unchanged; only explicit surfaces respond.
optional_stable_light_handle_call_its_re: Optional ref for the stable light handle. Call its refresh() method after position-only layout changes.
the_html_element_to_render_native_attrib: The HTML element to render. Native attributes and the ref follow the chosen tag; custom React components are not accepted here.
content_rendered_inside_the_host_use_a: Content rendered inside the element. Use a wrapper for inputs and other elements that cannot display the decoration themselves.
forwarded_to_the_rendered_element_alongs: Forwarded to the rendered element alongside the internal registration ref. React 19 callback-ref cleanup is preserved.
your_classes_combined_with_the_decoratio: Your classes, combined with the decoration classes.
your_inline_styles_merged_after_the_deco: Your inline styles, merged after the decoration bindings. Keep Edge-owned CSS variables intact unless deliberately overriding them.
choose_how_a_surface_responds_to_light: Choose how a surface responds to light without changing its base styles.
choose_a_style_and_move_your_pointer: Choose a style and move your pointer around the card. The selection also updates this site’s cards, code blocks and navigation surfaces.
highlights_the_edge_facing_the_light_def: Highlights the edge facing the light. Default.
reverses_the_direction_for_an_inset_appe: Draws the highlight one decorative edge thickness inward. Preserves the selected light direction.
the_effect_approximates_a_direction_on_a: The effect approximates a direction on axis-aligned rectangles, not a physical point light. Near the center, directional intensity fades over a region proportional to the surface size.
a_border_that_responds_to_your_pointer: A border that responds to your pointer.
your_component_keeps_its_own_colors_and: Your component keeps its own colors and layout.
give_your_assistant_current_edge_documen: Give your assistant current Edge documentation before it changes your UI.
these_files_are_generated_from_the_same: These files are generated from the same content as this site and identify the package version they describe. Publishing them does not guarantee that an assistant reads them automatically; include the URL in your request.
include_your_existing_component_and_the_: Paste the component you want to update and describe which elements should respond to the light. For example:

install_edge_and_load_its_stylesheet: Install Edge and start using it in React.
the_react_adapter_requires_react_18_or: The React adapter requires React 18 or 19. Other framework adapters are not available yet.
load_the_stylesheet_once_before_applicat: React prepares the default CSS automatically when a surface connects, with or without Edge.Provider. No stylesheet import is required. For SSR, render Edge.Styles once per document before application styles. If CSP requires a nonce, pass the same request nonce on the server and during hydration.
the_css_alternative_needs_a_build_tool: Existing CSS imports remain supported. The CSS file is also available for framework-independent use. When loading it explicitly, put it before application and utility styles; a reset may load first. Package CSS imports require a build tool that resolves package paths.
choose_whether_a_shared_light_follows_th: Choose whether a shared light follows the pointer or keeps a fixed direction.
try_each_mode_below_the_selection_update: Try each mode below. The selection updates the shared light across this site, including the example card.
respects_reduced_motion_and_input_prefer: Respects reduced motion and input preferences. Library default.
follows_mouse_or_pen_input_including_wit: Follows mouse, pen or touch contact, including with reduced motion enabled.
keeps_a_fixed_direction_ignores_pointer_: Keeps a fixed direction; ignores pointer movement.
without_a_precise_hover_device_lighting_: Without a precise hover device, lighting starts fixed. Mouse or pen input can enable tracking when reduced motion is off. Touch updates the light position in viewport coordinates. Scrolling and lifting the finger preserve the last position; surfaces respond as they move beneath it. A new touch updates the position.
offer_this_mode_as_an_explicit_choice: Offer this mode as an explicit choice because it overrides reduced motion. The effect stays hidden until mouse, pen or touch contact arrives.
choose_how_this_card_responds_to_movemen: Choose how this card responds to movement.
system_respects_your_motion_preferences_: System respects your motion preferences. Static keeps the direction fixed.
understand_lights_and_surfaces_before_co: Understand lights and surfaces before connecting your components.
a_light_controls_a_group_of_surfaces: A light controls a group of surfaces that respond together. Choose a section or a few elements to share one light.
a_surface_is_an_element_connected_to: A surface is an element connected to that light. Only connected surfaces respond. Use a separate light for an independent area.
edge_keeps_your_background_text_spacing_: Edge keeps your background, text, spacing and base border. Its highlight uses each surface’s own text color and border radius by default. Keep existing interactions and keyboard focus indicators.
handle_decoration_conflicts_native_input: Handle decoration conflicts, native inputs and layout changes.

motion_dynamic_hint: Follows your pointer, even when reduced motion is enabled.

surface_existing_element: Decoration aligns with the outside of the element's border. To connect an existing component’s HTML element, use <part0/>.

react_ref_versions: In React 18, an existing function component must use <part0/> to pass the ref to its HTML element. React 19 also supports receiving ref as a prop.

component_hook_rendering: <part0/> includes appearance classes and variables in server HTML. <part1/> leaves your markup unchanged until hydration. Geometry, fixed direction and pointer tracking require client code.
server_component_boundary: In Server Component frameworks, use Edge inside a client module marked with <part0/>.

react_shared_area: Wrap the area in <part0/> and mark each responding element with <part1/>. The two cards below share one light; nested providers create independent lights.
react_native_props: Use <part0/> to choose the HTML element. Native attributes, events and refs follow that element. Optional <part1/> and <part2/> props apply your styles. The provider adds no DOM; each surface renders one element.
